package fixture

import (
	"context"

	"metaldocs/internal/platform/tenant"
)

type actorContext = context.Context
type actorString = string
type actorError = error

// Type aliases preserve the exact actorFromCtx function type even though the
// source spelling no longer says context.Context/string/error.
func badActorFromCtxTypeAliases(ctx actorContext) (first, second actorString, err actorError) {
	_, err = tenant.FromContext(ctx)
	return "", "", err
}
